title: Certificate & Report To Be Considered Valid As Passport Issued To Miss Rufina Daniloff

page_data.en:
D 2330
File No............
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S.1, Special Branch Station,
REPORT
Date........ June 19, 1937.
Subject Communication dated 2.6.37 from the Netherlands Consulate-General
concerning The Daniloff-Danilevsky family.
Made by... D.S. Tcheremshansky ......... Forwarded by... [Signature]

Enquiries show that the Daniloff-Danilevsky family mentioned
in the anonymous letter to the Netherlands Consul-General at
Shanghai, is Mrs. O.M.Daniloff and her two daughters named
Ludmila and Ruffna, respectively, who are known by the stage
name of Danilevsky, and who form the subject of File D.2330.
Mrs. Daniloff and her children arrived in Shanghai from
Vladivostok about the year 1925 and subsequently resided for
various periods in Hankow, Shanghai and Tsingtao, where the
daughters worked as ballet dancers. They are also known to
have toured Japan, Manila and Netherlands East Indies in their
professional capacity of ballet dancers. Particulars regarding
the Daniloff family as known to this office, are as follows:-
1. Mrs. Olympiada Mihailovna Daniloff, Russian, born on 2.12.
1887 at Orenburg, Russia. She is separated from her husband
whose
Mr. V.N.Daniloff,/stage name is Raisky and who is an ex-officer
of Admiral Kolchak's Army. He resides at present at Harbin.
He is a member of the All-Russia Fascist Party and is attached
to the Headquarters of the party in Harbin. Mrs. Daniloff
returned to Shanghai from Manila on May 27, 1937 in the s.s.
"President Grant", together with her daughter Ludmila. At
present she is reported to be in Tsingtao. When in Shanghai
she resided at 32 Rue Molier.
2. Miss Tamara Vladimirovna Daniloff, who was born on 2.6.1910 at
Troitsk, Orenburg district, Russia is a professional ballet
dancer. She recently arrived in Shanghai from Hankow where she
had been working as a stage dancer and a dancing partner in
various local cabarets including the "International Cabaret".
3. Miss Ludmila Vladimirovna Daniloff, who was born on □□□
at Tashkent, Russian Turkestan, is a Ballet dancer.

D 2330
档案号............
上海公共租界工部局警务处。
S.1，特科分站，
报告
日期........ 1937年6月19日。
事由 关于达尼洛夫-达尼列夫斯基（Daniloff-Danilevsky）家族，荷兰总领事馆于1937年6月2日来函。
制作人... D.S. Tcheremshansky ......... 转呈人... [签名]

经查，致上海荷兰总领事的匿名信中所提及的达尼洛夫-达尼列夫斯基家族，系指O.M.达尼洛夫夫人及其两个女儿，名分别为柳德米拉（Ludmila）和鲁夫娜（Ruffna），她们以达尼列夫斯基为艺名，即本档案D.2330所涉对象。达尼洛夫夫人及其子女约于1925年从符拉迪沃斯托克（海参崴）抵达上海，随后在汉口、上海和青岛断续居住，期间女儿们担任芭蕾舞演员。据悉，她们还曾以芭蕾舞演员的职业身份巡回演出至日本、马尼拉及荷属东印度群岛。本局所掌握的达尼洛夫家族详情如下：-
1. 奥林匹亚达·米哈伊洛夫娜·达尼洛夫（Olympiada Mihailovna Daniloff）夫人，俄罗斯人，1887年12月2日出生于俄罗斯奥伦堡。她已与丈夫分居，其夫为V.N.达尼洛夫先生，艺名赖斯基（Raisky），系高尔察克海军上将部队的前军官。他目前居住在哈尔滨。他是全俄法西斯党成员，隶属于该党哈尔滨总部。达尼洛夫夫人于1937年5月27日与其女柳德米拉乘“格兰特总统”号轮船从马尼拉返回上海。据报她目前在青岛。在上海期间，她居住在莫利哀路（Rue Molier）32号。
2. 塔玛拉·弗拉基米罗芙娜·达尼洛夫（Tamara Vladimirovna Daniloff）小姐，1910年6月2日出生于俄罗斯奥伦堡省特罗伊茨克，是一名职业芭蕾舞演员。她最近从汉口抵达上海，此前她在当地多家歌舞厅工作，担任舞台舞者和舞伴，包括“国际歌舞厅”（International Cabaret）。
3. 柳德米拉·弗拉基米罗芙娜·达尼洛夫（Ludmila Vladimirovna Daniloff）小姐，出生于□□□，地点为俄属突厥斯坦塔什干，是一名芭蕾舞演员。

returned to Shanghai from Manila on May 27, 1937 in the s.s.
"President Grant" together with her child, one year of age,
which was born out of wedlock. It appears that she has resided
in Manila since the end of 1935.
4. Miss Rufina Vladimirovna Daniloff, who was born on 25.2.1920,
at Kustanai, Siberia is also a ballet dancer. She returned to
Shanghai on May 3, 1937 in the s.s. "President Hoover" from
Manila after a prolonged stay in that city. She is reported to
have been cohabiting with a government employee in Manila, an
elderly and well-to-do man. She has the reputation of being an
attractive and light hearted girl who is usually surrounded by
a host of admirers. It is reported that soon after her return
to Shanghai she was involved in a scandal, which took place at
the "Gardenia Private Club." 138 Yu Yuen Road, when one of her
admirers, a Frenchman, assaulted her and A.Vertinsky, proprietor
of the Club, both of whom he had surprised in a "tête-à-tête" in
a room above the dance hall.
5. Mrs. Valentina Vladimirovna Monet (nee Daniloff) who was born
on 10.2.1916 at Tashkent, Russian Turkestan, is a ballet dancer
by profession. Her husband, a Spaniard named Monet, is also
a professional ballet dancer, and conducted the "Blue Danube Bar"
(at the Paramount Ball Room) until its closure recently. The
couple is known under the stage name of "Don & Dolly, Ballet
Dancers." On May 27, 1937 they left for Japan on a professional
tour. While in Shanghai, they resided at the Paramount Hotel,
238 Yu Yuen Road.
6. Mr. Viacheslav Vladimirovich Daniloff, who was born on 2.6.1908
at Troitsk, Orenburg district, Russia, is a professional
musician. During the absence of the Monet couple from

于1937年5月27日与其一岁大的非婚生子女乘“格兰特总统”号轮船从马尼拉返回上海。看来她自1935年底以来一直居住在马尼拉。
4. 鲁菲娜·弗拉基米罗芙娜·达尼洛夫（Rufina Vladimirovna Daniloff）小姐，1920年2月25日出生于西伯利亚库斯塔奈，也是一名芭蕾舞演员。她在该市长期停留后，于1937年5月3日乘“胡佛总统”号轮船从马尼拉返回上海。据报她在马尼拉与一名政府雇员同居，该男子年老且富有。她被认为是一位迷人且性格轻浮的女子，周围通常簇拥着众多爱慕者。据报她回到上海后不久便卷入了一起丑闻，事发地点为位于愚园路138号的“栀子花私人俱乐部”（Gardenia Private Club）。当时，她的一名法国爱慕者在舞厅楼上的一个房间里撞见她与俱乐部老板A.韦尔廷斯基（A.Vertinsky）私下独处，遂袭击了二人。
5. 瓦伦蒂娜·弗拉基米罗芙娜·莫内（Valentina Vladimirovna Monet）夫人（婚前姓达尼洛夫），1916年2月10日出生于俄属突厥斯坦塔什干，职业为芭蕾舞演员。她的丈夫是西班牙人，名叫莫内，也是一名职业芭蕾舞演员，并经营“蓝色多瑙河酒吧”（位于百乐门舞厅内），直至近期停业。夫妇二人以“唐和多莉，芭蕾舞演员”（Don & Dolly, Ballet Dancers）的艺名闻名。1937年5月27日，他们前往日本进行职业巡回演出。在上海期间，他们居住在愚园路238号的百乐门酒店。
6. 维亚切斯拉夫·弗拉基米罗维奇·达尼洛夫（Viacheslav Vladimirovich Daniloff）先生，1908年6月2日出生于俄罗斯奥伦堡省特罗伊茨克，是一名职业音乐家。在莫内夫妇离开

Shanghai, he acted as manager of the "Blue Danube Bar". He is
reported to be an ardent anti-Bolshevik and member of the All-
Russia Fascist Party. He resides at 32 Rue Molier.
7. Mr. Boris Vladimirovich Daniloff, who was born on 2.4.1909 in
Orenburg district, Russia is a professional musician. He is
reported to be a light hearted person of rather dissipated habits.
He is very fond of his sisters. He resides at 32 Rue Molier
with other members of his family.
Enquiries at the American Consulate-General fail to
confirm the allegation contained in the anonymous letter referred
to above, that Mrs. Daniloff and her two daughters Ludmila and
Rufina were deported from Manila. They travelled on "certificates
of identity" issued by the French Consulate-General at Manila.
Mrs. Daniloff appears to have great influence over her
daughters and, if the statement of her husband is to be believed,
this influence is not a good one. In March, 1933 Mr. Daniloff
sent a letter to the "Council of United Russian Organizations",
(Soro) accusing his wife and three daughters of bad conduct and
misbehaving themselves generally and declining any responsibility
for their future conduct. There appears to be some truth in
his accusations; the Daniloff sisters appear to be typical ballet
dancers of bohemian habits and are reported to have enjoyed
great success among their many male friends in Manila. It is,
therefore, very likely that the writer of the anonymous letter
in question was inspired by jealousy in making his allegations
against Mrs. Daniloff and her two daughters.
Neither Mrs. Daniloff nor any of her daughters are known
to have any interest in politics or to have been connected with
any political parties.
D.C. (Special Branch)
J Tchemshansky
D S.

上海期间，他担任“蓝色多瑙河酒吧”的经理。据报他是一名狂热的反布尔什维克分子，也是全俄法西斯党成员。他居住在莫利哀路32号。
7. 鲍里斯·弗拉基米罗维奇·达尼洛夫（Boris Vladimirovich Daniloff）先生，1909年4月2日出生于俄罗斯奥伦堡省，是一名职业音乐家。据报他生性轻浮，生活相当放荡。他非常疼爱他的姐妹们。他与家人其他成员一同居住在莫利哀路32号。
向美国总领事馆查询后，未能证实上述匿名信中的指控，即达尼洛夫夫人及其两个女儿柳德米拉和鲁菲娜被从马尼拉驱逐出境。她们是持马尼拉法国总领事馆签发的“身份证明书”旅行的。
达尼洛夫夫人似乎对女儿们有很大的影响力，如果其丈夫的说法可信，这种影响并非良性。1933年3月，达尼洛夫先生致信“俄罗斯联合组织理事会”（Soro），指责其妻子和三个女儿行为不端，总体表现恶劣，并拒绝为她们未来的行为承担任何责任。他的指控似乎有一定真实性；达尼洛夫姐妹似乎是典型的具有波希米亚习气的芭蕾舞演员，据报在马尼拉的众多男性朋友中颇受欢迎。因此，这封匿名信的作者在针对达尼洛夫夫人及其两个女儿提出指控时，很可能是出于嫉妒。
达尼洛夫夫人及其女儿均不知晓有任何政治兴趣或与任何政党有关联。
D.C. （特科）
J Tchemshansky
D S.
（批注：2/6）

STRICKILY CONFIDENTIAL

Manila P I

Hon. Consul General of Holland
Shanhai China

Sir

This is to let you know that the Daniloff or Danilewski Familly
have just been deported from the Philippine Islands to Sahnghai They
are bolchevist and spies of Soviet Government.. They said they are going
to Java and Duch posesions and colonies to work as artist but all what
they are going to do is spreading the comunistic ideas in dutch colo-
nies. They are prostitutes and the so called mother Olimpiada Daniloff
is they pimp and procurer of lovers and she is advisers of many comu-
nist in the Orient

Do not give them visa in they passport otherwise you will regret
afterwards. They have been working before in Soerabaya in Circle Hollen-
dorn but they have disturbed many families on account of being prosti-
tutes and they took plenty of money from many maried men xx in that
city

Very respectfully yours.

One Detective of Police Department
Manila, Philippines

Note: This familly are living now in 32 Rue Molier, Shanghai, China.
Same.

菲律宾马尼拉

致荷兰驻中国上海荣誉总领事

先生

特此告知，达尼洛夫或达尼列夫斯基家族
刚刚从菲律宾群岛被驱逐至上海。他们
是布尔什维克和苏联政府的间谍。他们说他们要去
爪哇和荷兰属地及殖民地以艺术家身份工作，但他们
真正要做的是在荷兰殖民地传播共产主义思想。他们是妓女，
所谓的母亲奥林匹亚达·达尼洛夫是他们
的鸨母和拉皮条者，她是东方许多共产
主义者的顾问

不要在他们护照上给予签证，否则你们事后会后悔。他们以前曾在
苏腊巴亚的Hollendorn Circle工作，但由于是妓女，
他们扰乱了许多家庭，并从该市许多已婚男人那里骗取了大量钱财 xx

此致
敬礼。

警察局一名侦探
菲律宾马尼拉

S.2. Special Branch.
June 8, 1933.

V.N. Daniloff-Raisky.

Regarding the attached memo of the Officer i/c
Special Branch of May 25, 1933, the former No.1 musician
of the "Kavkaz Restaurant" is Vladimir Nikolaevitch
Daniloff, whose stage name is Raisky. He is a Russian
and was born on August 4, 1882 at Turgai, Siberia.
During 1924 he arrived in Tientsin from Vladivostok.
Here he was employed with Brenner & Co. In 1925 he
arrived in Shanghai and since that time he has been
working in various cabarets and restaurants as a
musician. He was separated from his wife Olimpiada
Michailovna Danilova, a professional actress, sometime
ago. Her stage name is Mrs. Danilevskaya. Daniloff
has four daughters and two sons. On March 22, 1933
he sent a letter to "Soro" (Council of Russian Public
Organizations at Shanghai) accusing his wife and three
of his daughters who are living with her at 7 Happy
Terrace, off Avenue Joffre of misbehaving themselves
and bad conduct in general. Daniloff is at present
employed with the "Cascade Restaurant" (former Kavkaz)
at No.1240 Rue Lafayette, Tel. No.70404, where he also
resides.

g. tcheremshansky.
D. S.

Officer i/c Special Branch.
JSR 8/6

达尼洛夫，艺名赖斯基。他是俄罗斯人，
1882年8月4日出生于西伯利亚图尔盖。
1924年，他从符拉迪沃斯托克（海参崴）抵达天津。
在此受雇于布伦纳公司（Brenner & Co.）。1925年他
抵达上海，自此一直在各家歌舞厅和餐厅担任
音乐家。他已于不久前与妻子奥林匹亚达·
米哈伊洛夫娜·达尼洛娃（Olimpiada Michailovna Danilova）分居，后者是一名
职业女演员。她的艺名是达尼列夫斯卡娅夫人。达尼洛夫
有四个女儿和两个儿子。1933年3月22日，
他致信“索罗”（上海俄罗斯公共组织理事会），
指责与其同住于法租界福煦路旁幸福坊7号的妻子和三个
女儿行为不端，总体表现恶劣。达尼洛夫目前受雇于
“卡斯卡德餐厅”（原高加索餐厅），
地址为霞飞路1240号，电话70404，他也居住于此。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT
（印：SHANGHI MUNICIPAL POLICE S.C. 805 I.R.C.S Station, No. S. B. D. 2330. Date May 7, 1931. at 7 - 5 - 31）
Subject (in full) Mrs. O.M. Daniloff-Danilevsky.
Made by D.S. Prokofiev. Forwarded by Whunean OSJ
Sir,
With reference to the attached letter of April 25, 1931 from the Consulate General for the Netherlands concerning Mrs. Olimpiada Mihailovna Daniloff-Danilevsky, enquiries show that she is the wife of Mr. V.N. Daniloff, an ex-officer of Admiral Kolchak's army, who at the present time resides in Tsingtao and is employed there with the British American Tobacco Co.
At the time of civil warfare in Siberia, while her husband was in active service, Mrs. Daniloff and her seven children took refuge first in Chita, Transbaikalian Province, and afterwards in Vladivostok. In Vladivostok her daughters received training as ballet-dancers and appeared in public performances in that town in 1922. They have been working as professional ballet-dancers since that time. After Vladivostok had been left by the "Whites" the Daniloff family remained there until about 1925 when they arrived in China. After a short stay in Shanghai they went to Hankow where the sisters Daniloff worked as ballet dancers for about one year. In Hankow Mrs. Daniloff met her husband who, after the defeat of the "Whites" in Siberia escaped to China at Chuguchak, Western Mongolia, and arrived in Shanghai via Peking and Tientsin. Mr. and Mrs. Deniloff soon parted and although they have not been formally divorced, they do not live together at the present time.
In the Spring of 1927 Mrs. Daniloff and her daughters returned to Shanghai and the daughters worked at local theatres and cabarets until their departure to Tsingtao, in the end of 1928. The elder daughter of Mr. and Mrs. Daniloff remained in the U.S.S.R. Two sons, Viacheslav and Boris

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 特别支部 805 国际红十字会站，编号 S. B. D. 2330。日期 1931年5月7日。于 31年5月7日）
主题（全称） O.M. Daniloff-Danilevsky 夫人。
由 D.S. Prokofiev 撰写。由 Whunean OSJ 转呈

先生，

关于随附的1931年4月25日荷兰总领事馆有关 Olimpiada Mihailovna Daniloff-Danilevsky 夫人的信件，经查询显示，她是 V.N. Daniloff 先生的妻子。V.N. Daniloff 先生是科尔恰克海军上将（Admiral Kolchak）军队的前军官，目前居住在青岛，并受雇于英美烟草公司。

在西伯利亚内战期间，当其丈夫服役时，Daniloff 夫人及其七个子女先是在外贝加尔省的赤塔避难，随后前往海参崴。在海参崴，她的女儿们接受了芭蕾舞演员的训练，并于1922年在该市公开演出。自那时起，她们一直作为职业芭蕾舞演员工作。在“白军”撤离海参崴后，Daniloff 一家留在那里直到约1925年，随后抵达中国。在上海短暂停留后，他们前往汉口，Daniloff 姐妹在那里作为芭蕾舞演员工作了大约一年。在汉口，Daniloff 夫人见到了她的丈夫；其丈夫在西伯利亚“白军”战败后，从蒙古西部的楚古查克（Chuguchak）逃往中国，经由北京和天津抵达上海。Daniloff 夫妇不久后分居，虽然尚未正式离婚，但目前并未共同生活。

1927年春，Daniloff 夫人和她的女儿们回到上海，女儿们在当地剧院和歌舞厅工作，直到1928年底前往青岛。Daniloff 夫妇的长女留在苏联。两个儿子，Viacheslav 和 Boris

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S.I. REGISTRY
No. S. B. D. 2330.
Date 6 - 5 - 31.

SHANGHAI, 25th April 1931.

Sir,

I have the honour to inform you that a certain Mrs.
Olimpiada Mihailovna Daniloff-Danilevsky, born at Orenburg,
2 December 1887, holder of a certificate of registration
No. 2142 issued by the Commissioner of Foreign Affairs at
Shanghai on 26 February 1929 and of a Chinese passport,
on 11 Oct. 1929
issued by the Special Municipality of Tsingtao, applied to
the Netherlands Consulate General at Kobe on the 20th of
April for a visé for admission into Netherlands' India for
herself and her daughters:

Tamara Vladimirovna Daniloff (stage-name Danilevsky), 20 or
21 years of age, holder of a Chinese passport, also issued
at Tsingtao on 11 October 1929,

Ludmila, born at Tashkent, 28 March 1913,
Valentina, " " " 10 February 1915,
Rufina, " " Kustanai, 25 March 1919.

They all appear to be ballet-dancers and intend to make a
trip through Netherlands' India.

I would be much obliged to receive any information you
may be able to give me, concerning these persons. I would
especially like to know whether there exists some relation
* See s.s.-D.1698 between these Daniloffs and P.A. Daniloff alias Svirsky alias
Gbankoff, who is connected with the quasi-anti-communist
organisation of Kizlo.
*

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

(签名)
Chinese Secretary.

(A)
R.C. Alers, Esquire,
Deputy Commissioner of Police,
Crime & Special Branches,
SHANGHAI.

S2, For attention please
(签名)

先生，

我谨通知您，一位名为
Olimpiada Mihailovna Daniloff-Danilevsky 的女士，1887年12月2日出生于奥伦堡，持有1929年2月26日由上海外事专员签发的第2142号登记证，以及1929年10月11日由青岛特别市签发的中国护照，于4月20日向荷兰驻神户总领事馆申请为其本人及女儿办理进入荷属东印度的签证：

Tamara Vladimirovna Daniloff（艺名 Danilevsky），20或21岁，持有同样于1929年10月11日在青岛签发的中国护照，

Ludmila，1913年3月28日出生于塔什干，
Valentina，同上，1915年2月10日出生，
Rufina，同上，1919年3月25日出生于库斯塔奈。

她们似乎都是芭蕾舞演员，打算在荷属东印度进行巡回演出。

如蒙提供有关这些人员的任何信息，我将不胜感激。我尤其希望了解这些 Daniloff 家族成员是否与 P.A. Daniloff（别名 Svirsky，别名 Gbankoff）存在某种关系*，此人与 Kizlo 的准反共组织有关联。
* 见 s.s.-D.1698

我谨此致意，
先生，
您顺从的仆人，

中文秘书。

R.C. Alers 先生，
副警务总监，
刑事与特别支部，
上海。

Заявленіе.
Антоніада Михайловна Данилова (по сценѣ Гале-
вская) бывшая моя жена при ней народились
двое сыновей: Любима 18 лѣтъ и Рудра 16 лѣтъ; она была
совѣтской подданной и имѣла соотвт-
ствующій документъ. Во время пребыванія
своего въ г. Владивостокѣ служила въ совт-
скихъ учрежденіяхъ при Управленіи (свѣд).
Находилась она въ безвѣстномъ отсутствіи
6 лѣтъ и всё это время проживала въ
различныхъ городахъ Россіи; пріѣхала она
въ Китай изъ г. Владивостока въ 1922 году,
исключительно, благодаря моей иниціативѣ
и моей матеріальной помощи. Розыскивая
я свою жену путемъ справокъ въ различ-
ныхъ адресныхъ столахъ и Театролитер
агенствахъ; списался съ ними и высылалъ на
протяженіи необходимую сумму денегъ. По
приходѣ ихъ работала съ ними на театраль-
номъ поприщѣ, разъѣзжая по всѣмъ городамъ
Китая въ продолженіи 2½ мѣсяцъ, а затмъ
вынужденъ былъ оставить свою семью не
всегда серьёзнымъ и побудительнымъ при-
чинамъ. По уходѣ моемъ отъ работы
по театрамъ, семья и клубная сцена
